title: FaCoDiff: Factor-Correlated Diffusion for Multivariate Probabilistic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.06166v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multivariate probabilistic forecasting requires modeling cross-variable dependence alongside marginal uncertainty. The challenge is to learn this dependence while controlling marginal noise scales and avoiding dense covariance costs. We propose Factor-Correlated Diffusion (FaCoDiff), which couples a compact conditional statistical estimator with structured denoising. History-conditioned factor loadings use distinct coefficients for forecast-center correction, scale adjustment and noise dependence. Diagonal compensation preserves the estimated marginal noise variances, while low-rank operators enable residual Gaussian likelihood evaluation and noise transport without dense covariance storage or factorization. Factor-derived feature modulation explicitly conditions the denoiser, and a geometry-aware objective accounts for errors after noise transport. The same conditional geometry governs forward perturbations and reverse sampling. Across

translated_title: FaCoDiff：面向多元概率预测的因子相关扩散模型
translated_abstract: 多元概率预测需要在刻画边缘不确定性的同时建模变量间的相互依赖关系。其挑战在于如何在控制各边缘噪声尺度、避免稠密协方差高昂计算开销的前提下学习这种依赖关系。我们提出因子相关扩散模型，将一个紧凑的条件统计估计器与结构化去噪相耦合。以历史数据为条件的因子载荷针对预测中心修正、尺度调整和噪声依赖分别使用不同的系数。对角补偿机制保留了估计出的边缘噪声方差，而低秩算子使得残差高斯似然评估与噪声传输无需存储或分解稠密协方差矩阵即可实现。源自因子的特征调制显式地对去噪器进行条件化，几何感知的目标函数则对噪声传输后的误差进行考量。同一条件几何结构同时支配前向扰动与反向采样过程。在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: FaCoDiff通过以历史为条件的因子载荷、对角补偿与低秩算子，将紧凑的条件统计估计与结构化去噪相耦合，在无需稠密协方差存储或分解的情况下实现高效的多元概率预测。
